milestones.title: The kill switch, exercised three more times
milestones.detail: The UNLIMITED burner's door was closed three more times: twice off-camera while rehearsing the demo, and once on camera for the launch video. Same one-signature approve(0), same result every time. Receipts: 0x31b93522..., 0xc5853b24..., 0xeea74257... (all on Blockscout).

milestones.title: Live-fire drill: 3 burners, 4 real txs — DANGEROUS 82 → killed → COMPLIANT 100
milestones.detail: We staged real approvals on three fresh Base wallets: unlimited USDC to a router, 1,000 USDC to an unverified contract, and an approve-then-close. Vette called all three correctly, then the dangerous door was closed onchain (0x03f63de2...) and re-audited: COMPLIANT 100. The drill also surfaced the score-floor rule — a live danger finding caps the verdict at DANGEROUS regardless of score (82 with an open unverified door is still DANGEROUS).

milestones.title: First autonomous run committed to the public repo
milestones.detail: run-msvqdvx4 checked the field and wrote its own history to github.com/hackid02/vette/data/agent-log.json. The agent now audits itself the way it audits everyone else — daily runs continue from the cron.

milestones.title: The chain moved — 0x61e1…4282: DANGEROUS 44 → DANGEROUS 28
milestones.detail: The same wallet, re-audited: four live approvals now instead of three. Vette reports the chain as it is, not as it was. Verdicts drift because reality drifts.

milestones.title: Three AI-assisted review passes: 13 → 21 → 24 out of 30
milestones.detail: Three rounds of AI-assisted code review raised 23 findings across the passes; the fixes are in production and the open items are tracked in the repo's checklist. Honest ledger entry: the remaining known items are the Telegram link (pending) and the optional model-narration key (off by design).

milestones.title: The refusal: BaseScout publishes a contract, Vette refuses to score it
milestones.detail: The only address on a top contest entry's page is the AERO token contract, not a wallet. No wallet declared, no verdict issued. The refusal is the finding — and it is the strongest thing Vette has ever done.

milestones.title: Caught on Base: unlimited USDC open to an unverified spender
milestones.detail: 0x61e1…4282, mined from real Approval events. DANGEROUS 44/100. One click ends each door.

milestones.title: Caught on Base: 8 live approvals, DANGEROUS 0/100
milestones.detail: 0x7850…abb2 — eight doors open, zero points. The worst score Vette has issued to date.

milestones.title: Vette goes live on Base
milestones.detail: AUDIT, GUARD and KILL shipped in one build: the deterministic engine, the public receipt, and the one-click kill switch — live at vette-nu.vercel.app.
